lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in parallel horizontal rows across the lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the spot rows, forming a characteristic checkerboard-like mesh at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity dorsal edge to a lower-intensity ventral shadow.
